input.summary: Start Herman Multiball, complete Lily and collect the DRAGULA add-a-ball under protection, then build Raven and Kitty before collecting stored Supers.

steps.text: Use a short plunge. Catch the ball on the right flipper. Test the Herman target and ramp returns.
Shoot lit red ramps for S-P-O-T. When Spot rises, hit it only if the feed is controlled.
modeNotes: Spot: Each lit red ramp adds a letter and briefly raises Spot. A Spot hit during that window adds a bonus letter.
Complete SPOT to start the timed mode and complete one character level.
During the mode, hit raised Spot four times. The hits score 150,000, then add 100,000 per hit. Four hits light a stored Spot Super.
If Spot returns dangerously, trap the ball and let the mode time out.

steps.text: Hit Herman to start the hurry-up. Hit Herman again to collect it and capture the ball.
modeNotes: After the capture, the game auto-plunges another ball.
Hit the captured ball to double the hurry-up and start three-ball Herman Multiball. A miss starts two-ball multiball.

steps.text: During Herman Multiball, complete L-I-L-Y. Shoot DRAGULA for add-a-ball.
modeNotes: Herman Multiball: Major shots score jackpots. Herman relights one completed jackpot. Every three Herman hits raises jackpot value.
Four jackpots light the stored Herman Super at DRAGULA. The feature ends when one ball remains.
Lily: Complete L-I-L-Y before the bank progress resets. Switches then score frenzy points; Lily hits raise their value.
At 100 switches, Lily lights a stored Super. An unfinished switch count persists to the next Lily attempt.

steps.text: Complete another character level. After its mode ends, collect the Raven advance at the left ramp. Repeat for three advances.
modeNotes: Raven advance: A stored step earned from another completed character level. The left ramp collects it.
Three collected advances start three-ball Raven Multiball.
During Raven, collect four major jackpots to light the stored Raven Super. Three left ramps start Raven Boost.
DRAGULA add-a-ball is immediately lit. If two balls drain before the Super, the left ramp can give a 15-second restart.

steps.text: Complete a character to light Kitty. Hit Kitty twice more to reach 6x. Then shoot DRAGULA to collect all stored Supers.
modeNotes: Kitty: A timed playfield multiplier. Kitty hits advance it from 2x to 3x to 6x and reset its timer.
Stacked Super: Character and side-feature Supers stay stored after a drain. DRAGULA collects all lit Supers together.
Hold the action button for one or two seconds to cancel a pending stacked collect and keep the Supers stored.

steps.text: Complete Grandpa last. One completed level for Spot, Herman, Lily, Raven, and Grandpa lights Munster Madness at the scoop.

fallback.title: Herman, Lily, and Raven first
fallback.when: Use this plan when direct Spot returns head toward the center drain.

steps.text: Short-plunge to the right flipper.
Start Herman Hurry-Up and Herman Multiball.
Complete L-I-L-Y and collect the DRAGULA add-a-ball during multiball.
Complete Grandpa.
Complete another character level, then shoot the left ramp to collect its Raven advance. Repeat until three advances start Raven Multiball.
Build Kitty to 6x and collect stored Supers at DRAGULA.
Return to Spot last. Use ramp loops to qualify it, then time out the dangerous mode from a cradle.

alternatives.title: Raven, Kitty, and stored Supers
alternatives.when: Use this as the scoring line when Munster Madness is too far away.

steps.text: Start Raven Multiball from three collected advances.
Collect DRAGULA add-a-ball.
Collect four jackpots for the Raven Super.
Shoot the left ramp three times for Raven Boost.
Start Kitty and reach 6x.
Collect all stored Supers at DRAGULA.
Complete one level for Herman, Lily, Grandpa, Raven, and Spot. Wait until no character mode is running.
Shoot the lit scoop to start Munster Madness.

editionDifferences.pro: The mode starts with four balls.
editionDifferences.premium: The mode starts with four main-playfield balls plus a fifth Lab ball.

techniques.name: Short-plunge Herman setup
techniques.instruction: Short-plunge to the right flipper. Use the controlled ball for the Herman target.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand Spot when the local copy gives a safer return than the forehand.

techniques.name: Drop catch
techniques.instruction: Drop-catch a controlled orbit return. Use a small nudge on a right-ramp return only after the tilt is known.

techniques.name: Drop catch
techniques.instruction: Use a drop catch on a controlled Herman return to regain a cradle.

techniques.name: Raven transfer
techniques.instruction: Use a controlled flipper transfer for the Raven left ramp. A small cabinet bump can move the return to the opposite flipper.

cautions.issue: Spot can send the ball down the middle.
cautions.response: Use the safer backhand. If the return remains unsafe, qualify Spot and let its mode time out from a cradle.

cautions.issue: Lily and DRAGULA are dangerous standup and lane shots.
cautions.response: Shoot them during Herman Multiball ball save.

cautions.issue: A tournament copy can have a sensitive tilt.
cautions.response: Test tilt tolerance before using cabinet movement on a return; use only the smallest proven nudge on this copy.

cautions.issue: A tournament copy can have little or no normal ball save.
cautions.response: Confirm the setting before using a hazardous mode-start shot.

input.overview: The Munsters advances five Family Members toward Munster Madness; Lily can run with other features. Start Herman Multiball, complete L-I-L-Y during it, and spell D-R-A-G-U-L-A for add-a-ball. Each completed Family Member lights Kitty and a Raven advance; hit Kitty up to 6x, then collect the left-ramp advance after the mode ends. Three advances start Raven Multiball; collect Supers at DRAGULA during 6x.
input.simpleOverview: The Munsters advances five Family Members toward Munster Madness; Lily can run with other features. Hit Herman to start the hurry-up, hit him again to capture the ball, then hit the captive ball for three-ball Herman Multiball (a miss starts two-ball). Complete L-I-L-Y during Multiball; each completed Family Member lights Kitty, whose hits advance timed playfield scoring from 2x to 3x to 6x.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At the 2018–2019 Stern Pro Circuit Finals, players opened with Herman Multiball, used its protection to work on Lily, built Kitty to 6x, and collected stacked Supers.

content.summary: Use red ramps for Spot, Herman for multiball, and Kitty for playfield X; use Raven when the left ramp is safer.

steps.title: Start Spot
steps.text: Shoot the lit red ramps to spell S-P-O-T. When Spot rises, hit it to start the character mode.

modeGuide.name: Spot
modeGuide.reason: Choose it when the red ramps and Spot return are controlled.
modeGuide.play: Hit raised Spot four times during the timed mode. The fourth hit lights a stored Spot Super.

steps.title: Start Herman Multiball
steps.text: Hit Herman to start the hurry-up, then hit him again to collect it and capture the ball. Hit the captured ball to start the three-ball version; a miss starts two-ball play.

steps.title: Start Kitty playfield X
steps.text: Complete a character to light Kitty, then hit Kitty twice more to reach 6x playfield scoring.

fallback.title: Alternative route: Raven Multiball
fallback.when: Use this when the left ramp is safer than Spot.

steps.text: Complete another character level. After its mode ends, shoot the left ramp to collect the Raven advance. Repeat this earn-and-left-ramp cycle three times to start Raven Multiball.
